page.layout: One page of text, with two circular portrait medallions at the top centre. Running head at the top centre with the page number at the top right. Two paragraphs of running text below the medallions. No margin notes.

main_text.l: DAGOBERTVS huius nominis primus,ac Francorum
Rex vndecimus succedit patri Clotario,huius nominis secun-
do,anno mundi 4593. à Christo nato 631. Hic viuo adhuc patre,
pædagogo barbam vulsit, virgísq; eum cædi iussit:pro miracu-
lo habetur,patris iram vitare potuisse. Fratri Ariberto Aquita-
niæ regnum in partem hæreditariam dedit:Sclauos adhuc ido-
lolatras debellauit. Effeminatus Dagobertus ,scortorū & pel-
licum agmen secum traxit:& variis in locis formosarū collegia
instituit,quæ vt Reginæ adornarentur: D.Amandus,id flagitij
corripiés,in exilium mittitur.Rex Iudæos omnes qui Christum
ampleāti nollent,edicto expulit. Templum D. Dionysij,ad Pa-
risios,à fundametis erexit:ex aliis vndequaque corrasit,quò id
vnū ditaret, nec quisquā ante eum patrimonij reditus annuos
templis tam profusè donauit.Vascones rebelles in fidem rece-
pit. Tandem profluuio ventris obiit anno regni 14. Pau. Emyl.
lib.1.Gag.lib.3.
CLODOVEVS, huius nominis secundus, Francorum
Rex duodecimus,succedit patri Dagoberto anno mun.4607.
à Christo nato 645. cùm Sigibertus natu maior Austrasia con-
tentus esset. Clodoeus & Ludouicus idem nomē est Germa-
nicè.Sigibertus,nulla prole suscepta,Ildebertū filiū Grimoaldi
adoptat:verùm mox nascitur illi filius Dagobertus:quem Gri-
moaldus valde puerū,& tonsum, & monachum in Scotiā mit-
tit,patre Sigiberto defuncto:& eundem Ildebertum Austriæ
Regem creat. Clodoeus hanc perfidiā minimè fert.Ildeberto
in bello occisio,Grimoaldus captus, Parisiis in carcere vitā mi-
serè finiit. Fames maxima Galliā inuadit:cui vt succurrat Clo-
doeus,thesauros & opes,quibus ædem D.Dionysij Dagober-
tus pater ornarat,aufert,obiítque anno regni 17.

page.notes: Two circular woodcut portraits with legends: left "DAGOBERTVS" and "FRAN.R.11."; right "CLODOVEVS" and "FRAN.R.12." Medallion legends are printed as picture captions, not transcribed as text. Doubtful readings: "ampleāti" (likely "ampleāti" with a macron-type abbreviation, read as printed); "Ludouicus", "Clodoeus" and "Dagobertus" spelled as printed; "Sigibertus", "Ildebertū" and "Grimoaldus" read with reasonable confidence. The "corrasit" and "Vascones" readings are clear enough but the word "Sclauos" is copied as printed.
